title: 全球首府与主要城市 · World capitals & cities

coverage.selection: All PPLC and PPLA, plus population >=100000 (excluding city sections/abandoned/historical places), plus original 243 Natural Earth places.
coverage.scope: Every PPLC/PPLA record in the source snapshot, with no population threshold for capitals. Administrative classifications follow GeoNames.

economy.source: GHS-UCDB R2024A V1.2, European Commission JRC
economy.method: Containment in UCDB 2025 urban-centre polygons (EPSG:54009). GDP is the modeled 2020 total for that urban centre, not municipal GDP or per-capita income. No nearest-city or country-value substitution.
economy.encoding: score = clamp((log10(GDP)-8)/4, 0, 1); radius = sqrt(2.25+40*score); opacity = 0.35+0.65*score. Stable across Type filtering. Missing GDP: hollow radius 2.1.

spatialLegend.title: Urban-centre economy · 2020 GDP (PPP)
spatialLegend.description: Larger / darker = larger estimated economy · logarithmic scale. 5,870 matched; 2,227 unavailable (hollow). Shared urban centres share an estimate; not municipal GDP.

metadata.note: Local-language titles, spherical coordinates, Type by continent. Cities are independent locations; no invented transportation links. Source names are explicitly marked when a local-language alternate is unavailable.
